rawContent: I swear Black movements need to find a way to trademark slogans to avoid being co-opted & diluted. I caught A LOT of flack for saying this, but look at how fast #BlackLivesMatter & #StayWoke have gotten hijacked for everything else. This is NOT a coincidence folks. #JournoLife https://t.co/CRQaLGYchk
This is utter BS. @E_Reid35 takes a stand for #BlackLivesMatter and gets slapped witha "random" doping test. Hmmmmm sounds very suspect.
But y'all want us to hush up about #SurvivingRKelly and #MeToo. Yeah ummm no. #MuteRKelly

I’ve covered so many #BlackLivesMatter cases since 2014 that the notion of “objectivity” and giving someone the “benefit of the doubt” became a frequent debate in my #JournoLife circles. https://t.co/XDdYcKzImh

When I was covering the attack on Austin school teacher #BreaionKing being body-slammed by officers during a traffic stop… I was shook for weeks. She lived! But the attack and the cop car convo haunts me. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/oToveFsLTu

#TamirRice will never have a chance to be on a national morning talk show to tell his side of the story. His family had to fight hard with press outlets to offer honest images of their child in an effort to show his humanity and prove he didn’t “deserve to die.” #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/esNdZwzOUb

Plus @JussieSmollett’s reputation is consistent w/ activism for #BlackLivesMatter, #LGBTQ issues, #FlintWaterCrisis #StandWithBennett and #TimesUp. Add in the Hollywood presence & he becomes a “good target” to send a message against diversity & inclusion if that’s your thing. IJS https://t.co/UouM5h1SRV

You can see #LaquanMcDonald 's body twist and turn. You can see the bullets hit the frozen ground as smoke emerges. I don't even know Laquan and I cried for days over this a few years ago. So sorry if her tears today are not moving me at all. #JournoLife #BlackLivesMatter

I'm conflicted here. I'm a #MeToo supporter. But knowing how the people in Sarasota are BIG on art installations, YOU HAD YEARS TO TARNISH THIS STATUE if you wanted to make a statement! To wait for the second the veteran died to do this seems off to me https://t.co/vREsCXRThe
